verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Both round-1 defects are resolved. The workflow is no longer scheduled while its required scanner is absent, and the parsed YAML self-test couples any future cron enablement to the scanner being present while retaining manual dispatch for an honest unverified result. Malformed or non-array issue-list output now returns nonzero without mutation or payload echo, including on both alerting and clean ticks, and the end-to-end tests pin that fail-closed behavior. The remaining workflow wiring, full-history checkout, scanner self-test-before-scan sequence, alert dedupe and recovery paths, public-sink bounds, least-privilege permissions, and SHA-pinned actions are consistent and non-vacuously exercised.
